name: Saloum Delta
description: On Senegal's Atlantic coast, the Saloum Delta is a maze of tidal channels, mangroves and more than 200 islands and islets where three rivers meet the sea. Locals have fished and gathered shellfish here for centuries, leaving 218 shell mounds, some hundreds of metres long. Burial mounds on 28 of them have yielded artefacts that trace the region's early settlement. Flamingos and spoonbills gather in the wetlands.
